name: Jasper Fel
summary: In Stormwind's Old Town, Jasper Fel supplies daggers and vials from SI:7 headquarters. He keeps watch on visitors and warns them to mind their speech.

sections.title: Supplies for the Shadows
sections.body: Inside SI:7 headquarters in Old Town, Jasper Fel supplies the agents who work there. He offers simple daggers and empty vials for brewing and applying poisons. Jasper works under Mathias Shaw's intelligence division and warns visitors to mind their speech. In a place built for espionage, careless words can put people in danger.

faq.q: Where can I find Jasper Fel?
faq.answer: Jasper Fel can be found inside SI:7 headquarters in the eastern part of Old Town, Stormwind City.
Jasper Fel supplies simple daggers and various grades of empty vials for operatives.

faq.q: Is Jasper Fel related to Morbent Fel?
aliases: is jasper fel related to morbent
faq.answer: Jasper Fel and Morbent Fel share a surname, but Jasper keeps silent about his personal matters.

faq.q: Why does Jasper Fel warn people to speak quietly?
faq.answer: Jasper Fel warns visitors to mind their speech because he works inside SI:7, Stormwind's espionage headquarters, where loose talk is dangerous.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can find vials and spare blades from Jasper Fel for your covert work in Stormwind.
As an Alliance member, you can rely on SI:7 headquarters to supply the agents who defend the kingdom from the shadows.
